text:
sam: Quick sync on model-output contract migration. We're removing the legacy `meta.diagnostics` blob in API v2; product asked for a gentle transition. proposal: an edge shim that synthesizes diagnostics on-demand, opt-in via header `X-RW-Compat: diagnostics=escrow`, per-tenant toggle.
maria: +1 on a transition window. main worry is perf/cost for high-qps tenants — can we get rough numbers?
leo: cheap heuristics for most requests, but expect ~5–15ms median overhead and extra GPU/CPU sampling in worst cases. embeddings-heavy flows may see higher variance.
olivia: Can we cache synthesized diagnostics for identical prefixes? that would cut repeated work. Also we need a Console flag and telemetry so customers know if they rely on the shim.
sam: Plan draft: 1) implement shim as a pluggable post-processor behind routing; 2) per-tenant opt-in toggle + header for canary; 3) expose metrics shim.latency, shim.qps, shim.cache_hit_rate and a shim_usage dashboard; 4) deprecation window 90 days after GA.
leo: + implement an early-abort path if shim path exceeds 150ms to avoid tail latency spikes. fallback behavior should be: return v2 response without diagnostics and mark header `X-RW-Compat-Status: timed_out`.
maria: Also let's add a warning lint in SDKs when clients include `meta.diagnostics` in requests, and a migration script to translate old clients to use the new structured diagnostics API. docs + changelog item required.
leo: Example header for canary payload:
```
POST /v2/generate
Headers: {
  Authorization: Bearer <token>,
  "X-RW-Compat": "diagnostics=escrow"
}
```
sam: For rollout: canary to 10 tenants (opt-in) → monitor shim metrics for 72h → expand to 50% with rate limit → full opt-in window. telemetry alert if shim.latency_p95 > 120ms or shim.error_rate > 0.5%.
compat-bot: Canary deployment scheduled to eng-ml-canary for 2025-09-02T18:00:00Z. :robot_face:
olivia: Re: privacy, ensure synthesized diagnostics do not leak any transient prompt content — apply redaction rules same as logging pipeline.
sam: Good catch. Add redaction step and mark as non-persisted unless tenant explicitly opts in with retention consent.
maria: I can own the docs + SDK lint PR. sam, please add rollout checklist and tenant opt-in UI spec in the RFC follow-up.
sam: Will open RFC follow-up PR with checklist, rollout steps, and telemetry dashboard links. tagging @maria @leo @olivia for review.
maria: Reviewing now, small comments incoming :eyes: 
leo: lgtm overall, one nit on cache key salt for prompt tokens.
sam: Thanks all — tracking card in Migration board, will update after PR. :thumbsup:
